python3 - <<'PY'
import pathlib
p = pathlib.Path('tests/codegen/io/streams.rs')
t = p.read_text()

edits = [
 ('''    let notices = out
        .stderr
        .matches("the $escape parameter must be provided")''',
  '''    let notices = out
        .diagnostics
        .matches("the $escape parameter must be provided")'''),
 ('''    let notices = out
        .stderr
        .matches("Cannot represent a stream of type MEMORY as a select()able descriptor")''',
  '''    let notices = out
        .diagnostics
        .matches("Cannot represent a stream of type MEMORY as a select()able descriptor")'''),
]
for old, new in edits:
    assert t.count(old) == 1, f"{t.count(old)} matches for {old[:40]!r}"
    t = t.replace(old, new)
p.write_text(t)
print("both fixed")
